title: 1. A man of a contrite and humble spirit

segments.text: For thus saith hee, that is high and excellent, he that inhabiteth the eternitie, whose name is the holy one, I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to reuiue the spirit of the humble, and to giue life to thē that are of a contrite heart.
The sacrifices of God are a contrite spirit, a contrite and a broken heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
